title: Degree under affine composition
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube over the two-element field to that field, and let $L$ be any affine map from this cube to itself. The algebraic degree of $f$ composed with $L$ is at most the algebraic degree of $f$.
